messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: High tail latency detected for embed-service (p99 > 2s) across us-west regions. Pager sent to #eng-oncall. alert: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/1092
Alex Chen: acked, on it. any obvious customer impact?
Maria Gonzales: seeing elevated client retry rates, around 3% of embedding requests are timing out, some customers reported slow pages. not wholesale outage.
Kevin Patel: looking at metrics now. can someone post the p50/p95/p99 numbers?
Leah Park: p50 120ms, p95 820ms, p99 2.3s. request rate steady. KV cache miss rate spiked ~10m ago. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.com/embed-service-latency
Alex Chen: thanks. does this line up with the cache eviction job that ran earlier?
Leah Park: yes eviction job completed 12m ago in us-west-2, small error burst during rollover. some workers are thrashing serving cold KV caches.
Paul Ortiz: rolling restart of embed workers might help. spinning additional pods could reduce cold misses. can we scale temporarily?
Maria Gonzales: scaling up + rolling restart sounds good. I'll take the scale. Alex can coord restart?
Alex Chen: scaling to +30% now. triggering rolling restart on a subset to avoid mass cold cache.
SRE-Triage-Bot: NOTE: This alert has historically been noisy during cache rollovers. Recommend squelch for duplicates and create a dedicated dashboard panel for cache-miss correlation.
Kevin Patel: quick mitigation: scale applied, restarting 6 pods gradually. monitoring error budget and latencies.
Leah Park: after first 3 restarts p99 dropped to 1.1s, cache-miss rate falling. continuing restarts.
Alex Chen: good signal. paging status -> will keep monitoring for 15m before rerouting. any requests for immediate customer communication?
Maria Gonzales: not yet, ops only. small subset saw transient failures, no escalations. I'll flag CS for visibility but no outbound yet.
Paul Ortiz: note for followup: add annotation to alert to include eviction job as likely cause so next oncall can triage faster.
Kevin Patel: agreed. immediate plan: 1) keep scale until steady, 2) add temporary silencing rule for duplicate alert signatures, 3) file runbook update to document eviction interaction, 4) create cache-specific dashboard panel. owners below.
Alex Chen: incident status: mitigated. p99 stabilized ~600ms across regions, client retry rate back to baseline. closing the urgent page but leaving monitoring hooks open.
incident-bot: Incident resolved: alert 1092 auto-closed after threshold recovery.
Alex Chen: post-incident actions I want tracked in this thread so next oncall picks them up.
Maria Gonzales: I'll open the runbook PR. PR link: https://git.redwood.internal/runbooks/pulls/458
Maria Gonzales: runbook changes to include: - add section on eviction-induced cold cache - checklist for safe rolling restarts - recommended temp-silence tags and who approves them
Kevin Patel: I'll make the alert rule tweak. current rule:
```yaml
alert: EmbedServiceHighP99
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(embed_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) > 2
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-service
```
Kevin Patel: proposed: raise threshold to 2.5s for paging path and add label evictions_sensitive=true so we can suppress during scheduled maintenance. new rule draft in ops repo: https://git.redwood.internal/ops/alert-rules/pulls/123
Leah Park: I'll build the cache-miss panel and a per-worker heatmap. dashboard draft: https://dash.redwood.com/d/8f/embed-service-cache-insights
Paul Ortiz: assign ownership: Maria -> runbook PR and customer notes; Kevin -> alert rule change + silencing automation; Leah -> dashboard; Alex -> post-incident blameless doc and ensure CI checks on eviction job.
Alex Chen: add timeline snippet to oncall playbook under section 'handling eviction-related latency spikes' with the exact steps we used.
SRE-Triage-Bot: Reminder: add alert fingerprinting to reduce duplicates. Recommend using labels: region, eviction_job_id, worker_pool.
Maria Gonzales: PR merged for runbook update, link: https://git.redwood.internal/runbooks/pulls/458/files. added checklists and a pointer to the eviction job runbook.
Kevin Patel: alert rule PR merged to ops repo: https://git.redwood.internal/ops/alert-rules/pulls/123. silencing automation tweak added to allow 1h safe window during eviction windows.
Leah Park: new dashboard panel live. ops dashboard link: https://dash.redwood.com/d/8f/embed-service-cache-insights?panel=2
Paul Ortiz: created a short playbook checklist card and pinned to eng-oncall channel. card: https://trello.redwood.com/c/abc123
Alex Chen: final notes: we avoided customer-wide impact, mitigation was scaling + rolling restart, root cause likely eviction rollover coupled with worker cold caches. owners assigned and docs updated. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
Maria Gonzales: thanks team. I'll follow up with CS summary for impacted customers tomorrow.
Alex Chen: good work. let's keep the silence rules conservative and monitor for any regressions.
SRE-Triage-Bot: Auto-note: Runbook last updated by Maria Gonzales at 2026-03-15T14:05:00Z.
